campaign.name: And Then the Dragons Came: Purewater
campaign.description: A Classic Fantasy Imperative port of 'And then the Dragons Came', relocated to Purewater -- a Venice-like canal city where the sacred waters of the Lake Lady meet the sea. Baron Hanzo di Teufel arrives with his Dragon Knights for the Lake Lady's Tourney, his possessed champion concealed among them. Four strangers arrive the same week. Built as a living world: every NPC and faction runs its own agenda on a clock, and what the party does not witness happens anyway.
campaign.myth-current-scene: d6/night. Southern intake work bay. Nimras waited while Rennic truthfully denied being from Marr’s and said he is comparing an old survey with the intake. Survey now beside fitter’s board. The fitter says her task is an estimate and offers the order for inspection; it has not yet been read in detail by Nimras. No identification of the mages beyond that activity, installation or agreement. All parties present; Invisibility uncast MP15 Luck5. Same watch.

recent_events.summary: Nimras’s cautious Perception check succeeds: 14 against70. He spots the broken tread corner before entry.
Nimras keeps Invisibility prepared without casting and watches Rennic while they enter by the known intact footing. They find chalk marks at an old intake grille.
Nimras watches as Rennic checks the chalk and leads towards a measuring crew in the adjoining bay.
Nimras joins Rennic in the work light. The fitter asks whether they are from Marr’s and describes the proposed lockable gate.
At Nimras’s pause Rennic answers truthfully; the fitter explains she is estimating and offers the order.

acts.title: THE FAVOUR AND THE ERRAND
acts.for: Expose the waterfront's competing organisations through consequential choices about people, cargo and authority. Bring Nimras's outside commission into that city through Vey's offered case and an independently reachable teacher at Lantern Float Market. Let Nimras decide how to approach recovery rather than require loyalty to a particular patron.
acts.takes: At risk: cargo, safe access, independent livelihoods, trust between teacher and pupil, and possession of the entrusted manuscript. Actual losses require events and failed resistance; nothing is forfeited merely for entering the act.

acts.title: THE WATERFRONT DIVIDES
acts.for: Offer physical objectives involving money, boats, armed control and closed routes. If the teacher's survey or recovery remains live, braid Nimras's hunt into existing Q5 at the Old Customs Cisterns. His magic, investigation, social work and fieldcraft can alter access and protect or obstruct actual people. Opponents use surviving resources and earned knowledge.
acts.takes: At risk: free passage, homes, market safety, research access and lives during any actual armed clearance. Effective intervention can prevent these consequences. No necessary casualty, teacher betrayal or PC setback.

acts.title: WHO HOLDS THE WATER
acts.for: Resolve control of the waterfront using the assets and opportunities that survived play. If Nimras's commission is still open, make any agreed return or handover a concrete operation along actual available routes. Give him authority over his own promises and report to his employer. Support victory, negotiated settlement, partial success, defeat or withdrawal without a predetermined ending.
acts.takes: At risk: lasting freedom of carriage, displaced crews' futures, the manuscript's custody and Nimras's professional relationships. None must be lost by design; actual outcomes determine the price.

nimras.name: Nimras
nimras.description: Nimras: human Rank 2 Magic-User, freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. Left amicably to spread his wings. Review draft; not yet in play.
nimras.content: Nimras is a freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. He left on good terms to choose his own work and establish his independence. The fellowship has commissioned him to find his former teacher Rennic Vaur in Purewater and recover an entrusted manuscript. His introduction to Oren Vey is his first proposed lead. He holds no Crown warrant. Alignment and passions remain the player’s choice. No arrival, target sighting or scene has been played.

background.authority: No Crown warrant; fellowship training does not make him an Assayer.
background.style: Direct battle magic, protection and pursuit; precise skills, spells and abilities unchosen.

background.continuity: Join the existing Purewater campaign at d6/dusk after the tournament and Hanzo’s departure. No rewind or advance.

cfi_rules_notes: Rank 2: base 2 AP +1; base POW Luck 3 + human 1 + Rank 2 table 1 =5.
CON+SIZ 25: use CFI HP table, then +1 in each location at Rank 2.
INT/4 memory fractions rounded down following engine skill guidance.
Rank 2 spells cost normally; lower-rank spell final costs reduced by 2 per rank difference, minimum 1 MP.
No spell is forgotten merely by successful casting. Arcane casting requires freedom from armour and shields.
No additional paid Rank abilities granted; no unspent advancement budget invented.
Locale and Customs refer to his home region, not automatic knowledge of Purewater. Home region and fellowship name remain undecided.
Navigation and Track are untrained Professional skills and have not been added under other names.

outlook.manner: Tries to be pleasant and amiable.
outlook.boundaries: Does not tolerate people messing with him.
outlook.lethal_force: Willing to kill when he thinks it necessary; the player decides when that is.
